verzen.tekst: “O God of my ancestors and Lord of mercy,
verzen.html: “O God of my ancestors and Lord of mercy,

verzen.tekst: and by your wisdom you formed man,
verzen.html: and by your wisdom you formed man,

verzen.tekst: and rule the world in holiness and righteousness,
verzen.html: and rule the world in holiness and righteousness,

verzen.tekst: give me wisdom, her who sits by you on your thrones.
verzen.html: give me wisdom, her who sits by you on your thrones.

verzen.tekst: because I am your servant and the son of your handmaid,
verzen.html: because I am your servant and the son of your handmaid,

verzen.tekst: For even if a man is perfect amongst the sons of men,
verzen.html: For even if a man is perfect amongst the sons of men,

verzen.tekst: You chose me to be king of your people,
verzen.html: You chose me to be king of your people,

verzen.tekst: You gave a command to build a sanctuary on your holy mountain,
verzen.html: You gave a command to build a sanctuary on your holy mountain,

verzen.tekst: Wisdom is with you and knows your works,
verzen.html: Wisdom is with you and knows your works,

verzen.tekst: Send her from the holy heavens,
verzen.html: Send her from the holy heavens,

verzen.tekst: For she knows all things and understands,
verzen.html: For she knows all things and understands,

verzen.tekst: So my works will be acceptible.
verzen.html: So my works will be acceptible.

verzen.tekst: For what man will know the counsel of God?
verzen.html: For what man will know the counsel of God?

verzen.tekst: For the thoughts of mortals are unstable,
verzen.html: For the thoughts of mortals are unstable,

verzen.tekst: For a corruptible body weighs down the soul.
verzen.html: For a corruptible body weighs down the soul.

verzen.tekst: We can hardly guess the things that are on earth,
verzen.html: We can hardly guess the things that are on earth,

verzen.tekst: Who gained knowledge of your counsel, unless you gave wisdom,
verzen.html: Who gained knowledge of your counsel, unless you gave wisdom,

verzen.tekst: It was thus that the ways of those who are on earth were corrected,
verzen.html: It was thus that the ways of those who are on earth were corrected,
